column1: # The basics every IDE user expects, as Wicked must keep them: the command (VS Code's id where it has one), where it
# lives (workbench = the palette's commands; editor = the code editor's own keys), and its keys on Linux as people read
# them ("" = no default keys). BasicsContractTests fails when a row's command is gone or its default keys changed.
# Rows are added as each phase of the second pass lands; a row is removed only with the user.
